cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with placenta percreta with bladder invasion who underwent a cesarean section and received ACAR-style bladder sutures during uterus-sparing surgery or hysterectomy.
finding: ACAR-style bladder suturing in cases with placenta percreta and bladder invasion resulted in a statistically significant increase in postoperative urinary incontinence and nocturia compared to the preoperative period.
